{{SystemsNav|title=Ranged Weapons}} [[Ranged Weapons]] are [[Weapons|weapons]] that can be used against distant opponents, as opposed to [[Melee Weapons|melee weapons]]. See the main [[Weapons]] article for full information. Note: Recipes here are made with [[Carpentry]] except for a few which use [[Smithing]] or [[Tailoring]]. These have been noted below. Ammunition can be obtained with [[Create Ammunition]] feat or made with both [[Carpentry]] and [[Smithing]]. See those articles for recipes and stats. == Mighty Property == Mighty is a ranged weapon item property that adds the character's strength modifier as physical damage for ranged weapons attacks. Ranged weapons by default have one of the following properties: *Mighty: 0 The weapon will cause less damage if the wielder has a negative strength modifier. *Mighty: ∞ The weapon will add all the character strength modifier to the damage roll. *Mighty: X The weapon will ignore the character strength modifier completely. == Parry AC == [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=355372#p355372 08/01/25:] Unless otherwise mentioned, all [https://nwn.fandom.com/wiki/Throwing_weapon Throwing Weapons] , with the exception of [https://wiki.nwnarelith.com/Ranged_Weapons#Sling Sling], gain [[Parry|Parry AC]] while the off-hand remains empty. ==Weapon List== ===Dart=== Base Damage: 1d4
